responsibility: This implementation module supplies the GNU Modula-2 runtime support for Logitech-compatible raw memory block operations. It wraps Builtins memcpy, memmove, and memset where possible and otherwise performs explicit byte- and word-wise loops to move, clear, fill, compare, and scan arbitrary address ranges, providing low-level storage utilities distinct from the bit-oriented BlockOps companion modules and the file-oriented FileSystem module.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of BlockOps: unlike BlockOps.def, it performs the actual memory movement, clearing, filling, comparison, and search logic using Builtins and explicit byte/word iteration.
